newsitem.title: UK: Northern Electric to unveil strategy - paper.
newsitem.headline: Northern Electric to unveil strategy - paper.

text.p: Britain's Northern Electric Plc will unveil the first part of its legal defence against a hostile takeover from a U.S. power producer on Monday, the Financial Times reported.
It said the northeastern English power company would dismiss a 630 pence per share bid by CalEnergy Co Inc as too low and would say the independent power producer had hinted at more.
According to the FT, there are market rumours that more bids are coming in the electricity sector.
On Friday, the Evening Standard newspaper reported that CalEnergy was set to raise its offer -- causing a rise in Northern Electric's share price.
Seven of Britain's original 12 regional power firms have been taken over in less than two years. CalEnergy already owns more than 29 percent of Northern.
